faq.a: Current American guidelines define high blood pressure as 130/80 or higher on repeated readings. A reading of 180/120 or higher, especially with chest pain, shortness of breath, weakness or vision changes, needs emergency care: call 911.

faq.a: Blood pressure that stays above goal despite three medicines from different classes at good doses, usually including a diuretic. It often has a fixable cause, which is why it deserves a closer look.
